info.name: FazeSoft-EMS API Checks
info.description: Automated check of every FazeSoft-EMS API endpoint. Run with the Postman Collection Runner (folder order matters). Signup/login runs first and saves the JWT; resource folders chain create -> list -> get -> update -> delete. HR/Admin-only endpoints expect success OR 403 and only fail on 5xx.

exec: pm.test('signup responds (201 or 409 if exists)', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(code));
pm.test('create-employee responds (201 or 409 if exists)', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(code));
pm.test('PATCH status skipped (candidate not created)', () => pm.expect(true).to.eql(true));
pm.test('PATCH status responds (200 or 403 for non-HR)', () => pm.expect([200, 403]).to.include(code));
pm.test('DELETE /candidates/{id} responds (204 or 403 for non-HR)', () => pm.expect([204, 403]).to.include(code));
pm.test('create interview responds (201 or 403 for non-HR)', () => pm.expect([201, 403]).to.include(code));

body.raw:
{
  "candidate_name": "API Check Candidate",

exec: pm.test('DELETE /interviews/{id} responds (204 or 403 for non-HR)', () => pm.expect([204, 403]).to.include(code));
pm.test('PATCH read skipped (notification not created)', () => pm.expect(true).to.eql(true));
pm.test('create project responds (201 or 403 for non-admin)', () => pm.expect([201, 403]).to.include(code));

exec: pm.test('assign team responds (201 or 400 if already assigned)', () => pm.expect([201, 400, 403]).to.include(code));
pm.test('list project teams skipped (no project)', () => pm.expect(true).to.eql(true));
pm.test('create team responds (201 or 403 for non-admin)', () => pm.expect([201, 403]).to.include(code));
